_comment: Episode catalog for the Dusty Farts website and RSS feed. Durations are exact seconds measured by ffprobe on the 128kbps files; sizes are the 128kbps file byte counts (needed for RSS enclosure length). Episodes 1 and 2 were encoded earlier by Brian - verify their duration/size locally with ffprobe before generating the feed. RELEASE DATES CONFIRMED BY BRIAN 2026-08-28 - use as-is, do not re-ask.

show.title: Dusty Farts
show.author: Brian Clark
show.description: Two old friends, one booth, and enough coffee to fuel a small-town power grid. Dusty Farts is an immersive comedy podcast that blends Americana warmth with absurd banter, diner-grade philosophy, and a touch of the surreal.
show.artwork: Dusty Farts Logo 1400 by 1400 at 80 percent.jpg
show.logoAlt: Two older men sit in a red vinyl diner booth, coffee mugs and condiment bottles between them, a glowing neon “Polyester Lounge — Bottomless Coffee” sign in the window behind. A handwritten caption below reads “Dusty” with an arrow to the man on the left and “Farts” with an arrow to the man on the right: don’t feed them after noon.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.art: Dusty Farts Logo 1400 by 1400 at 80 percent.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF01 Pilot.docx
episodes.artAlt: Two older men sit in a red vinyl diner booth, coffee mugs and condiment bottles between them, a glowing neon “Polyester Lounge — Bottomless Coffee” sign in the window behind. A handwritten caption below reads “Dusty” with an arrow to the man on the left and “Farts” with an arrow to the man on the right: don’t feed them after noon.
episodes.summary: Two forty-year friends claim a booth at the Polyester Lounge and redefine friendship as sarcasm, side orders, and one more refill of regret.

episodes.title: Grease Trap Gospel
episodes.art: 02 Grease Trap Gospel Art (1400 by 1400) at 80.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF02 Grease Trap Gospel.docx
episodes.artAlt: An empty red, cream, and teal diner booth sits in a garage bay: two steaming coffee mugs on the table beside an old drip coffeemaker, a car up on a lift, and a framed roadside-mascot photo on the wall behind.
episodes.summary: The boys make their weekly pilgrimage to the Jiffy Lube — not for oil changes, but for the free coffee and a front-row seat to the greasy ballet.

episodes.title: Lounge Lizards
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF03 Lounge Lizards.docx
episodes.artAlt: Two bearded dragon lizards, one wearing sunglasses, perch on the back of booth number three in front of a glowing “Polyester Lounge” neon sign, while two cups of coffee and two plates of buttered toast sit on the table below.
episodes.summary: A hijacked prayer-request group chat becomes a coffee-rating scandal, and it turns out not all biscotti comes from a bakery.

episodes.title: Nut Jobs
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF04 Nut Jobs.docx
episodes.artAlt: Two squirrels perch on the back of a red diner booth beside a small orange cooler, eyeing a ham sandwich, a dish of shredded nuts, and a bowl of little hot dogs set out on the table.
episodes.summary: John declares the park's squirrels a covert operation; Fred invents a rating scale for nuts, because if coffee gets one, so should pecans.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF05 Blood Brothers.docx
episodes.artAlt: Two matching recliners sit in a blood-donation room, IV poles and bags on either side, a plate of chocolate chip cookies on the table between them, medical supplies lined up on the counter above.
episodes.summary: The boys discover the blood donor bus has free cookies and recliners that basically count as a booth — Dr. Bobby's medical wisdom optional.

episodes.title: Nuts and Dolts
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF06 Nuts and Dolts.docx
episodes.artAlt: A bearded garden gnome in a red coat stands on an end table between two toilets in a warehouse aisle, holding a length of hose, with a potted plant, a lit taper candle, and a pink flamingo nearby.
episodes.summary: Dusty and Farts set up camp on two toilets in a hardware store, taste-test espresso from a gnome, and turn plumbing into prophecy.

episodes.title: Fight Club
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF07 Fight Club.docx
episodes.artAlt: Two goats wearing red boxing gloves stand in a parking lot in front of the glowing Polyester Lounge sign and a “Marquis of Sheepsberrie” delivery truck, a microphone and speaker set up between them like a weigh-in.
episodes.summary: A thermostat argument escalates into a full goat-boxing pageant in the parking lot, refereed by actual goats.

episodes.title: Jiffy Part Deaux
episodes.art: 08 Jiffy Part Deaux Art (1400 by 1400) at 80.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF08 Jiffy Part Deaux.docx
episodes.artAlt: An empty diner booth scrawled with doodled stars and stick figures in marker, a lone coffee mug and two pens on the table, a car-repair garage visible through the doorway behind.
episodes.summary: Sharpie graffiti on the booth starts a turf war, and somewhere between torque angles and postal-carrier betting, Fred gives away his smart watch.

episodes.title: Freudean Fouls
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 9, Freudean Fouls.mp3
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF09 Freudean Fouls.docx
episodes.artAlt: An empty YMCA gymnasium with a scoreboard reading “Maple Grove” on the wall and basketballs scattered across the floor, two worn diner-style booth benches pulled up to a folding table set with mismatched mugs and a pitcher.
episodes.summary: The boys wander into the wrong therapy circle at the YMCA and come out with ink blots, doodles, and opinions about their own subconscious.

episodes.title: Jingle Jamboree
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 10, Jingle Jamboree.mp3
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF10 Jingle Jamboree.docx
episodes.artAlt: A swirling, psychedelic poster in reds, teals, and purples: a steaming mug of coffee and a harmonica flank two squirrels holding coffee beans, above a curved diner booth, under lettering that reads “Jingle Jamboree.”
episodes.summary: Aria hijacks the show for a jingle retrospective — every Dusty Farts earworm ever recorded, replayed, and lightly regretted.

episodes.title: Condiment Clash
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 11, Condiment Clash.mp3
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF11 Condiment Clash.docx
episodes.artAlt: A map split down the middle like warring nations: ketchup, relish, and mayonnaise on the red side, sriracha, mustard, and rice on the blue side, titled “Condiment Clash.”
episodes.summary: A missed blood-bus appointment turns hangry, and one wrong squirt of ketchup ignites a full tabletop condiment war.

episodes.title: Booth or Treat - The Maple Grove Spooktacular Special (Parts 12 and 13)
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 12 and 13, Booth or Treat - The Maple Grove Spooktacular Special.mp3
episodes.art: 12 and 13 Booth of Doom Art (1400 by 1400) at 80.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF12 and 13 Booth or Treat - A Maple Grove Spooktacular Special.docx
episodes.artAlt: The open tailgate of a hearse at dusk: two small wooden coffins nested in cobwebs, a bubbling cauldron, a sheeted ghost, and piles of Halloween candy laid out like trick-or-treat loot, titled “Booth or Treat: Booth of Doom.”
episodes.summary: The boys build the Booth of Doom out of a borrowed hearse and two discount coffins for Maple Grove's Trunk or Treat contest.

chapters.title: A Ruling on the Booth of Doom

episodes.title: Drip, Drip, Horray!
episodes.art: 14 Drip, Drip, Horray! Art (1400 by 1400) at 80.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF14 Drip, Drip, Horray!.docx
episodes.artAlt: A converted mobile blood-drive bus painted with a garish banner reading “Doctor Bobby’s Rolling Vein Drain Extravaganza,” donor recliners and IV equipment visible through its windows, titled “Drip, Drip, Horray!”
episodes.summary: John unlocks a self-diagnosed detective talent he calls Clue-dini, and the blood bus never fully recovers.

episodes.title: Murder in the Park
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 16, Murder in the Park.mp3
episodes.art: 16  Murder in the Park art (1400 by 1400) at 65.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF16 Murder in the Park.docx
episodes.artAlt: A comic-style park scene: two older men in trench coats sit at a picnic table under a “Maple Gump Park” sign examining evidence with a magnifying glass, surrounded by inset panels of muddy sandal prints, a syringe and gloves, a bench with a dropped hot dog, and scattered gems, titled “Murder in the Park.”
episodes.summary: Clue-dini returns for his toughest case yet: a dead squirrel, on the table, in the booth.

chapters.title: An unfamiliar sight at a familiar booth

episodes.title: All Power to the Ball
episodes.audioSource: chat-delivered or re-encode from .render/DustyFarts, Volume 17 All Power to the Ball.mp3
episodes.art: 17 All Power to the Ball art (1400 by 1400) at 60.jpg
episodes.showNotes: Podcast work/Show Notes/Show Notes DF17 All Power to the Ball.docx
episodes.artAlt: A glittering, multicolored New Year’s Eve ball atop a wooden rigging tower wired to a control panel, fireworks and balloons overhead, a banner reading “All Power to the Ball — Happy New Year 2026.”
episodes.summary: Maple Grove unplugs itself fridge by fridge in pursuit of one clean New Year's countdown for the Ball.
